#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int INF = 1000*1000*1000;

struct rib {
	int b, u, c, f;
	size_t back;
};

void add_rib (vector < vector<rib> > & g, int a, int b, int u, int c) {
	rib r1 = { b, u, c, 0, g[b].size() };
	rib r2 = { a, 0, -c, 0, g[a].size() };
	g[a].push_back (r1);
	g[b].push_back (r2);
}

int main()
{
	int N, m, k, c, d;
	scanf("%d %d %d %d %d", &N, &m, &k, &c, &d);
	int n = N * 101 + 2;
	vector < vector<rib> > g (n);
	for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
		int x;
		scanf("%d", &x);
		x--;
		add_rib(g, n - 2, x*101, 1, 0);
	}
	for (int i = 0; i < 101; i++)
	{
		add_rib(g, i, n-1, INF, i*c);
	}
	for (int i = 1; i < N; i++) {
		for (int j = 0; j+1 < 101; j++) {
			add_rib(g, i*101 + j, i*101 + j + 1, INF, 0);
		}
	}
	for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
		int u, v;
		scanf("%d %d", &u, &v);
		u--;
		v--;
		for (int j = 0; j+1 < 101; j++) {
			for (int K = 1; K <= k; K++) {
				add_rib(g, u*101 + j, v*101 + j + 1, 1, d*K*K - d*(K-1)*(K-1));
				add_rib(g, v*101 + j, u*101 + j + 1, 1, d*K*K - d*(K-1)*(K-1));
			}
		}
	}
	int s, t;
	s = n-2;
	t = n-1;
	int flow = 0, cost = 0;
	while (flow < k) {
		vector<int> id (n, 0);
		vector<int> d (n, INF);
		vector<int> q (n);
		vector<int> p (n);
		vector<size_t> p_rib (n);
		int qh=0, qt=0;
		q[qt++] = s;
		d[s] = 0;
		while (qh != qt) {
			int v = q[qh++];
			id[v] = 2;
			if (qh == n)  qh = 0;
			for (size_t i=0; i<g[v].size(); ++i) {
				rib & r = g[v][i];
				if (r.f < r.u && d[v] + r.c < d[r.b]) {
					d[r.b] = d[v] + r.c;
					if (id[r.b] == 0) {
						q[qt++] = r.b;
						if (qt == n)  qt = 0;
					}
					else if (id[r.b] == 2) {
						if (--qh == -1)  qh = n-1;
						q[qh] = r.b;
					}
					id[r.b] = 1;
					p[r.b] = v;
					p_rib[r.b] = i;
				}
			}
		}
		if (d[t] == INF)  break;
		int addflow = k - flow;
		for (int v=t; v!=s; v=p[v]) {
			int pv = p[v];  size_t pr = p_rib[v];
			addflow = min (addflow, g[pv][pr].u - g[pv][pr].f);
		}
		for (int v=t; v!=s; v=p[v]) {
			int pv = p[v];  size_t pr = p_rib[v],  r = g[pv][pr].back;
			g[pv][pr].f += addflow;
			g[v][r].f -= addflow;
			cost += g[pv][pr].c * addflow;
		}
		flow += addflow;
	}
	assert(flow == k);
	cout<<cost<<endl;

}

import sys

class rib:
    def __init__(self, b, u, c, f, back):
        self.b = b
        self.u = u
        self.c = c
        self.f = f
        self.back = back

def add_rib(g, a, b, u, c):
    r1 = rib(b, u, c, 0, len(g[b]))
    r2 = rib(a, 0, -c, 0, len(g[a]))
    g[a].append(r1)
    g[b].append(r2)

def main():
    N, m, k, c, d = map(int, input().split())
    n = N * 101 + 2
    g = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(k):
        x = int(input()) - 1
        add_rib(g, n - 2, x * 101, 1, 0)
    for i in range(101):
        add_rib(g, i, n - 1, float('inf'), i * c)
    for i in range(1, N):
        for j in range(101):
            add_rib(g, i * 101 + j, i * 101 + j + 1, float('inf'), 0)
    for i in range(m):
        u, v = map(int, input().split())
        u -= 1
        v -= 1
        for j in range(101):
            for K in range(1, k + 1):
                add_rib(g, u * 101 + j, v * 101 + j + 1, 1, d * K * K - d * (K - 1) * (K - 1))
                add_rib(g, v * 101 + j, u * 101 + j + 1, 1, d * K * K - d * (K - 1) * (K - 1))
    s, t = n - 2, n - 1
    flow, cost = 0, 0
    while flow < k:
        id = [0] * n
        d = [float('inf')] * n
        q = [0] * n
        p = [0] * n
        p_rib = [0] * n
        qh, qt = 0, 0
        q[qt] = s
        d[s] = 0
        while qh != qt:
            v = q[qh]
            id[v] = 2
            if qh == n:
                qh = 0
            for i in range(len(g[v])):
                r = g[v][i]
                if r.f < r.u and d[v] + r.c < d[r.b]:
                    d[r.b] = d[v] + r.c
                    if id[r.b] == 0:
                        q[qt] = r.b
                        if qt == n:
                            qt = 0
                        qt += 1
                    elif id[r.b] == 2:
                        if qh == -1:
                            qh = n - 1
                        q[qh] = r.b
                        qh -= 1
                    id[r.b] = 1
                    p[r.b] = v
                    p_rib[r.b] = i
        if d[t] == float('inf'):
            break
        addflow = k - flow
        for v in range(t, s, -1):
            pv, pr = p[v], p_rib[v]
            addflow = min(addflow, g[pv][pr].u - g[pv][pr].f)
        for v in range(t, s, -1):
            pv, pr, r = p[v], p_rib[v], g[pv][pr].back
            g[pv][pr].f += addflow
            g[v][r].f -= addflow
            cost += g[pv][pr].c * addflow
        flow += addflow
    assert(flow == k)
    print(cost)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
